request.utterance: npm 공급망 공격 관련해서 실무자용 리서치 하나 써줘. GitHub/npm이 2025년 말부터 trusted publishing이랑 npm v12 스크립트 기본 차단 같은 걸로 계속 방어를 강화했다고 했는데, 8월에 터진 CHAINDROP(Shai-Hulud 계열) 웜은 그 방어가 정확히 겨냥했던 preinstall 스크립트 경로로 뚫었잖아. 공개된 공식 발표랑 실제 인시던트 리포트들 찾아서, 방어 강화랑 이번 침해가 실제로 어떻게 맞물리는지(또는 안 맞물리는지) 근거 기반으로 정리해줘. suengj.com에 올릴 글이고, 화면에 넣을 차트는 필요 없어.

transformation.basis: utterance asks to take multiple separately-published sources (npm's hardening announcements and independent incident reports) and "근거 기반으로 정리해줘" (put together, evidence-based) how they relate — combining material into one synthesized reading, not summarizing one document.

content_type.basis: utterance names "리서치" explicitly and asks for an evidence-first answer to a stated tension (does the hardening actually cover this incident), matching research.json's intent field.

audience.basis: utterance says "실무자용" (for practitioners) directly, and the request assumes familiarity with npm publishing mechanics, CI/CD, and lifecycle scripts without needing them defined from scratch.

surface.basis: utterance says "suengj.com에 올릴 글" (a piece to publish on suengj.com).

artifacts.basis: utterance asks for a written research piece ("리서치 하나 써줘"); text/article is the planned text-artifact id in the artifact axis registry (editorial/profiles/axes.json), not yet built as a standalone profile — governed here by article.schema.json (V1), same as run-01's intake record.

sources.note: GitHub's own Sept 2025 mitigation plan — the utterance's "trusted publishing" reference.
GitHub's June 2026 announcement of npm v12's install-script defaults changing — the utterance's "npm v12 스크립트 기본 차단" reference.
GitHub's July 8, 2026 changelog confirming npm v12 shipped with the announced defaults live.
Elastic Security Labs' Aug 6, 2026 incident report on CHAINDROP — the utterance's "8월에 터진 CHAINDROP" reference and primary source for the incident itself.
Independent Aug 4, 2026 incident analysis, used to cross-check Elastic's package count and to check whether npm v12 was discussed.
Third independent Aug 6, 2026 incident analysis, used as a second cross-check on the same two questions.
